text: {"lessons":["I should avoid selling a stock and later buying it back without a clear change in its outlook; every trade needs a reason beyond recent price moves.","Buying after a sharp rise can mean chasing momentum, so I should compare each stock’s prospects and risk with the price before adding to a position.","I should review the whole portfolio regularly, including cash and position sizes, and make deliberate changes rather than reacting to short-term account swings."]}
